title: Table of Curriculum for an Agricultural School
caption_extra: Showing Subjects of Study, Standard and Number of Hours per Week Allotted to Their Teaching
footnotes: Remarks:—
1. Gymnastics may be left out if the local conditions do not permit.
2. Besides the hours given in the above table, more than 9 hours per week shall be allotted to practical exercises concerning agriculture.
3. It is permissible to give in the 1st grade the lesson concerning vegetables and in the second grade a part or all of the lessons relating to special crops.
4. The filature should be assigned in the agricultural practice.
5. The number of hours may be increased up to two hours per week in case the fishery is taught.
transcriber_notes: Read once by Claude Haiku 5.5 (llm CLI) from the page; not checked by eye.
context: The table sets out the subjects, standards and weekly hours allotted in each grade of an agricultural school's curriculum, with remarks on flexibility in gymnastics, practical work and fishery.

footnotes: REMARKS:—

rows: Matters concerning Crops, sericulture, Live-stock and forestry.

footnotes: Remark :—

1. Besides the hours given in the above table, practical exercises in agriculture should be given in taking into consideration the local conditions in accordance with the following methods: a.
